enforced_by: the copywriter and the video teardown read it; nothing refuses an unknown value
note: One list per dial — humour, delivery style, register, pacing, reference world, avoid; the asset is the dial.

rows.name: cringe-register
rows.what: The register this room mocks, named by the room, in the room's own words.

extra.when: Every section, every level. It is checked against the chosen register and delivery style before anything is written.

rows.name: ad-voice-tells
rows.what: The tells that mark a piece as an ad before a claim is heard: the announcer lift at the end of a line, stacked superlatives, the too-clean read, the sell turn in the first seconds, the smile held past the end of the sentence, the grade that matches no room anyone lives in.

extra.when: Every piece, and hardest wherever the room's scepticism toward advertising is the main barrier.
